items.headline: Western Michigan hits the road to play Rice

items.headline: C.J. Carr throws for 4 touchdowns as No. 3 Notre Dame routs visiting Rice 52-0
items.description: — C.J. Carr threw for four touchdowns and No. 3 Notre Dame overpowered visiting Rice early on the way to a 52-0 victory on Saturday.

items.headline: No. 3 Notre Dame faces familiar triple-option offense when it returns home to face Rice
items.description: — Notre Dame linebacker Jaiden Ausberry recognizes Rice's triple-option offense.

items.headline: Rice rolls up 465 yards on ground in 31-3 win over Houston Christian
items.description: — Led by Tyvonn Byars with 104 yards, Rice rode a 465-yard rushing effort to a 31-3 victory over FCS opponent Houston Christian on Saturday in the first meeting between the two teams from Houston.
